differences.title: 1. CORE PHILOSOPHY
differences.leftDesc: Compiles components to imperative vanilla JS, no virtual DOM, no runtime overhead.
differences.rightDesc: Focuses on shipping less JS by default, serving static HTML first.

differences.title: 2. REACTIVITY MODEL
differences.leftDesc: Updates DOM directly without VDOM diffing for maximum efficiency.
differences.rightDesc: Hydrates components individually on demand, minimizing client-side JavaScript.

differences.title: 3. RENDERING
differences.leftDesc: Supports SSR, SSG, CSR, and app-like SPA experience.
differences.rightDesc: Prioritizes static generation and server-side rendering for speed.

differences.title: 4. JS BUNDLING
differences.leftDesc: Compiles away unused code, keeping bundle sizes exceptionally small.
differences.rightDesc: Ships JS only for interactive components, not the entire page.

differences.title: 5. FRAMEWORK INTEGRATION
differences.leftDesc: Built-in routing, server endpoints, and form actions.
differences.rightDesc: Integrates with many UI frameworks (React, Vue, Svelte, etc.).

differences.title: 6. PERFORMANCE FOCUS
differences.leftDesc: Exceptional runtime performance due to compilation and no VDOM.
differences.rightDesc: Blazing fast initial load times by minimizing client-side JS.

differences.title: 7. DEVELOPMENT EXPERIENCE
differences.leftDesc: Uses Svelte's concise syntax for components and logic.
differences.rightDesc: Use your favorite framework for interactive UI parts.
